label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
Here's a draft you can copy and paste:

---

**Subject: I'm safe, and thank you (please read before sending me anything)**

Hi everyone,

This is one letter to answer the hundreds of messages I can't get to one by one. My phone has been going nonstop since Saturday night and I'm so tired. Please forgive me for not replying to each of you. I've read every single one, and I've cried at most of them.

**First, I'm okay.**
I'm safe and so is Marmalade. We're staying with my sister in Rondebosch.

**What happened**
On Saturday 7 November, around 11:40pm, a fire started in a ground floor flat at Lindale Court on Station Road in Obs. I'm on the second floor, in flat 12. All 14 flats were evacuated and everyone got out. Two people were treated for smoke inhalation at Groote Schuur and were sent home the same night.

The fire department thinks it was probably an electrical fault, but they're still investigating, so I'm not going to guess or say more than that.

I woke up because our neighbour, Uncle Faizel, banged on every door on our floor in his vest and slippers. I honestly don't know what would have happened without him. I grabbed my phone and Marmalade and ran. Marmalade hid under a car for two hours afterwards and wouldn't come out, but she's fine now.

My flat has smoke and water damage everywhere and the lounge ceiling came down. The landlord says nobody can move back in for at least six weeks. Furniture can be replaced. Marmalade can't, and we're both here, so I'm holding on to that.

The things I'm sad about are small and specific. I'd taken home all the things I'd made for our end of year concert to laminate: 22 crowns and the Ladybirds' handprint banner. Those are gone. I'll remake them. It's just a bit of a gut punch.

**What I actually need**
I hate asking for help, so I'm going to be specific so nobody has to guess:

- Help towards a deposit on a new place. This is the big one.
- School shoes and work clothes: shoes size 6, clothes size 34.
- A laptop, if anyone has an old one lying around that still works. All my lesson planning was on mine.

**What I don't need**
Please don't take this the wrong way, because the generosity has been overwhelming:

- Clothes in general. I already have more than I can carry. Anything extra I'll pass on to the other families from the building.
- Food. My sister's freezer is completely full.

To the mom who dropped a bag of clothes on my sister's gate at 7am on Sunday and left without knocking: thank you. I know who you are, and it made me cry in the best way.

**The fundraiser (and a warning)**
My friend Zinhle set up a BackaBuddy page for me. I felt weird about it, I'll be honest, because I'm the one who usually organises things for other people. Zinhle told me to shut up and accept it, so I'm accepting it.

This is the only official page:

**backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court**

The target is R25 000, and as of this morning it's at R11 400. I can't tell you what that means to me. Every rand goes toward getting me into a new place.

**Please be careful, because there is a fake.**
Some of you have sent me a link to a "Thandi Fire Relief" page on another site, or a WhatsApp message asking people to EFT money to a Capitec account. **That is not me and I have nothing to do with it.** I've reported it. I'm not running any other fund, and I'm not asking anyone for bank transfers by WhatsApp.

If you get one of those messages, please don't pay and don't forward it. If you already sent money to it, please contact your bank as soon as you can. And if you're ever unsure about something that claims to be from me, check with Zinhle or me directly before you send anything.

**For the Little Acorns parents**
The concert on 27 November is still happening, so please don't worry about it. The Ladybirds will have crowns. They might look slightly less laminated than planned, but they will be crowns.

I'm back at school on Wednesday. I'd really appreciate it if you didn't make a big thing of it in front of the kids. They're four and five, and I want things to feel normal and happy for them. A quiet hello is perfect. I'll happily take a hug at pick-up if you really can't help yourself.

**Last thing**
I'll be slow replying to comments, and I probably won't get to most DMs. Please don't be offended. It's not you, I'm just running on very little sleep and a lot of tears. Feel free to forward this letter to anyone who's asking, so I don't have to explain it all again.

People have been amazing. I mean it. Thank you for checking on me, for the clothes, the offers, the voice notes, and for just sitting with me in all of this. I'm going to be okay, and a lot of that is because of you.

With so much love,
Thandi
(Ladybirds teacher, Little Acorns, and Marmalade's human)

---

Two quick things to check before you send it. I wrote "back at school on Wednesday" the way you had it, but today is already Wednesday 11 November. If you mean next Wednesday, change it to "Wednesday the 18th" so nobody is confused. Also, I didn't include any account details for the fake page, which is deliberate so nobody accidentally copies them. Want a shorter version for WhatsApp status or the school parent group as well?
